newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Chinese drug group to list shares in Singapore.
newsitem.headline: Chinese drug group to list shares in Singapore.

text.p: Tianjin Zhong Xin Pharmaceutical Corporation Ltd said on Wednesday it had won approval in principle to list on the main board of the Stock Exchange of Singapore.
A company statement said it would be the first Chinese state enterprise to get a primary listing in Singapore.
Tianjin Zhong Xin is a leading manufacturer of Chinese pharmaceutical products with 221 registered products.
The group's main market is China which accounts for 93 percent of sales, while the balance is exported.
The company also has three foreign joint ventures with SmithKline Beecham and Italy's Bieffe Medital S.p.A. to make western medicines.
